# QS-CFW-6417-61 Quality specification - bearing ring CFW-6417-61 (52100)

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1  
Parts: CFW-6417-61

Scope
This quality specification applies to the forging and post-forge processing of bearing ring CFW-6417-61 (CFW-6417-61) manufactured from 52100. It defines the acceptance criteria, inspection methods, and nonconformance handling for the part as supplied from Plant P1.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Material | 52100 | Per material control plan |
| Hardness (core or surface where specified) | 29-35 HRC | Hardness range for bearing ring CFW-6417-61 (CFW-6417-61) is 29-35 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.07 mm | The bore diameter tolerance for bearing ring CFW-6417-61 (CFW-6417-61) is ±0.07 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | 9.4 kg | The maximum forging weight for bearing ring CFW-6417-61 (CFW-6417-61) is 9.4 kg. |

Inspection method
- Dimensional inspection: Verify bore diameter and related dimensions using calibrated measuring equipment appropriate to the tolerance. Record results on the inspection record.
- Hardness testing: Perform hardness measurements at production-specified locations. Hardness readings shall be reported and compared to the requirement 29-35 HRC.
- Weight verification: Confirm forging weight does not exceed 9.4 kg by weighing the forging prior to heat treatment.
- Calibration: Use equipment with valid calibration status. Maintain inspection records with identification of inspector and equipment used.

Nonconformance handling
- Any part failing to meet a requirement in the Requirements table is nonconforming.
- Tag and segregate nonconforming parts immediately. Document the nonconformance on the internal nonconformance report and include measured values and inspection evidence.
- Disposition options include rework to specified requirements or scrap as determined by quality authority in accordance with internal procedures.
- Use traceability to contain affected lots and prevent release until disposition is approved.
